description: Add navigation methods to the List widget to allow programmatic movement through list items. The implementation should ensure the selected index always stays within valid bounds when using these navigation methods or when setting the index directly.
functional_requirements: Add first(), last(), previous(), and next() methods to the List widget for navigation
Clamp the selected index to valid bounds (0 to list length - 1) when using navigation methods
Apply the same bounds clamping when setting the selected index directly via select() method
Update the list example to demonstrate the new navigation functionality
